description: This file defines a React functional component called CompatibilityScore, which renders an animated circular score meter with mastery and growth counts. It is used in the explore section of the application to display compatibility-related metrics, with props to configure scores and counts.

methods.name: CompatibilityScore
methods.description: A React functional component that renders an animated circular score indicator with optional mastery and growth counts. It provides a visual representation of a compatibility score with smooth animations using framer-motion.
